from unittest.mock import Mock

import youtube_dl.postprocessor.common as common


def test_try_utime_updates_file_times(monkeypatch):
    downloader = Mock()
    postprocessor = common.PostProcessor(downloader)
    encoded_path = "encoded-file"
    encode_filename = Mock(return_value=encoded_path)
    utime = Mock()

    monkeypatch.setattr(common, "encodeFilename", encode_filename)
    monkeypatch.setattr(common.os, "utime", utime)

    encode_filename.assert_called_once_with("original-file")

def test_try_utime_reports_warning_when_update_fails(monkeypatch):
    downloader = Mock()
    postprocessor = common.PostProcessor(downloader)
    encoded_path = "encoded-file"
    encode_filename = Mock(return_value=encoded_path)

    def failing_utime(path, times):
        raise OSError("utime failed")

    monkeypatch.setattr(common, "encodeFilename", encode_filename)
    monkeypatch.setattr(common.os, "utime", failing_utime)

    postprocessor.try_utime(
        "original-file",
        10,
        20,
        errnote="Unable to update file times",
    )

    encode_filename.assert_called_once_with("original-file")
    downloader.report_warning.assert_called_once_with(
        "Unable to update file times"
    )

from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from youtube_dl.postprocessor.common import PostProcessor


def make_postprocessor(params):
    postprocessor = PostProcessor.__new__(PostProcessor)
    postprocessor._downloader = SimpleNamespace(params=params)
    return postprocessor


def test_configuration_args_returns_default_when_not_configured():

    default = ["--default-option"]

    result = postprocessor._configuration_args(default)

    assert result is default


def test_configuration_args_returns_configured_postprocessor_args():
    configured_args = ["--input", "value"]
    postprocessor = make_postprocessor(
        {"postprocessor_args": configured_args}
    )

    result = postprocessor._configuration_args(["--unused-default"])

    assert result is configured_args
